verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services such as venture capital, IP, and data protection work, not a software platform, so official developer SDKs are outside its product category. Its internal use of AI and a blockchain-based trading platform is not a developer-facing SDK, and the probes found no published API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
